source.name: HC Neftekhimik official site: OLIMPBET стал партнёром ХК «Нефтехимик»
source.quote: Контракт рассчитан на три года, и в рамках сотрудничества логотип букмекера будет размещён на плечах игровой формы хоккеистов команды.
source.note: Club announcement of the three-year OlimpBet deal: the bookmaker's logo is placed on the shoulders of the team's playing kit. OlimpBet is also the only logo under 'Partners of HC Neftekhimik, season 2026-2027' on the club partners page.

summary: 2026-27 home kit. OlimpBet official partner; its logo is on the shoulders of the playing kit under a three-year deal announced by the club in September 2025. The club partners page lists no other club partner for 2026-27; front-of-shirt and other placements not documented on a source we could open.
